content.value_statement: Code review feedback can be unclear, incomplete, or wrong for the current codebase. This skill helps agents verify suggestions before changing code.
actual_capabilities: Structures a response pattern for reading, understanding, verifying, evaluating, responding, and implementing review feedback.
Prompts clarification before partial implementation when review items are unclear.
Separates feedback from trusted project owners and external reviewers.
Encourages checking existing code usage before adding unused features.
Prioritizes multi-item feedback by blockers, simple fixes, and complex changes.
Provides templates for factual technical pushback and corrected assumptions.
limitations: Does not inspect code automatically or prove that a review suggestion is correct.
Requires access to the relevant codebase, tests, and project constraints.
Focuses on receiving review feedback, not writing a full code review.
Uses an opinionated communication style that may need team adjustment.

use_cases.title: Handle Ambiguous Review Notes
use_cases.description: Identify unclear review items and ask targeted questions before editing the code.

use_cases.title: Evaluate External Suggestions
use_cases.description: Check whether external feedback fits the codebase before accepting or rejecting it.

use_cases.title: Plan Safe Review Fixes
use_cases.description: Sequence multi-item review work so blockers, simple fixes, and risky refactors stay separate.

prompt_templates.title: Clarify Unclear Feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: one review has unclear items.
prompt_templates.prompt: I received review feedback with unclear items. Help me separate what I understand from what needs clarification before I edit.

prompt_templates.title: Verify A Suggestion
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: an external reviewer suggests a change.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this feedback against the current codebase context. Tell me what to verify before I accept or push back.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Review Fixes
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: several review comments need action.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an implementation order for these review comments. Separate blockers, simple fixes, complex changes, and required tests.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare Technical Pushback
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: feedback may conflict with project constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me write a concise technical response explaining why this review suggestion may be wrong for this codebase.

output_examples.input: A reviewer asks to remove legacy logic, but platform support may still require it.
output_examples.output: First verify supported platform versions and current tests. If legacy support is required, explain the compatibility reason and ask whether to fix or remove support.

output_examples.input: A review has six items, and two of them are unclear.
output_examples.output: Pause implementation and ask about the unclear items first. State which items are understood and which need clarification.

output_examples.input: A reviewer suggests building a complete metrics feature, but no current code calls the endpoint.
output_examples.output: Check actual usage before adding scope. If unused, ask whether to remove the endpoint or confirm the missing requirement.

best_practices: Verify review feedback against real code and tests before implementation.
Ask for clarification when review items may affect each other.
Implement and test review fixes one item at a time.
anti_patterns: Accepting external feedback without checking project context.
Implementing clear items while related review items remain unclear.
Adding professional-sounding features that no current workflow uses.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps agents evaluate code review feedback before changing code, especially when feedback is unclear or questionable.

faq.question: Does it perform code review automatically?
faq.answer: No. It guides how to receive and verify review feedback that someone else has already provided.

faq.question: Can it help push back on bad feedback?
faq.answer: Yes. It encourages concise technical reasoning when a suggestion conflicts with code, tests, or project constraints.

faq.question: Should every review comment be implemented?
faq.answer: No. The skill recommends verifying whether each comment is correct, needed, and compatible with existing behavior.

faq.question: How does it handle unclear comments?
faq.answer: It recommends stopping before implementation and asking specific clarification questions for the unclear items.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
